descriptionChirho: Adverb expressing sudden, unexpected occurrence. All four clusters denote the same concept with prepositional variation (b-/l-). Multilingual glosses are unanimous: Spanish 'de repente / súbitamente / en un instante' (suddenly), Arabic فَجأَةً / بَغْتَةً (suddenly), Korean 갑자기 / 순간 / 순식간에 (suddenly / in a moment / in an instant), Hindi अचानक / झट से / एकाएक (suddenly / quickly / all at once), Swahili ghafla / mara moja (suddenly / at once). No genuine semantic distinction exists between these clusters.
